title: Switch
description: Toggles a single setting on or off, with immediate effect.

props.name: checked
props.description: Whether the switch is on (controlled)

props.name: defaultChecked
props.description: Initial state (uncontrolled)

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables the switch. Inherited from an enclosing FormControl when not set; an explicit `false` overrides the FormControl

props.name: size
props.description: Switch size

props.name: color
props.description: Semantic color of the "on" state (checked thumb and track, active side label / segment)

props.name: shape
props.description: Shape of the track and thumb

props.name: variant
props.description: "slider" is the classic track + thumb; "segmented" renders two pressable segments (requires offLabel and onLabel, otherwise falls back to slider)

props.name: label
props.description: Label displayed next to the switch

props.name: offLabel
props.description: Label of the "off" state. With onLabel, both labels are rendered as buttons on each side of the slider (they replace `label`) or as the segments of the segmented variant

props.name: onLabel
props.description: Label of the "on" state (see offLabel)

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible label, required when the switch has no visible label. Set on the switch input (on the segment group for the segmented variant)

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: id(s) of the element(s) labelling the switch (on the segment group for the segmented variant). Defaults to the enclosing FormControl's label for the segmented variant

props.name: aria-describedby
props.description: Extra id(s) of elements describing the switch, merged with the enclosing FormControl's helper / error text

props.name: name
props.description: Name of the input, used in forms

props.name: id
props.description: id of the input (defaults to the enclosing FormControl's id)

props.name: value
props.description: Value submitted with the form when on

props.name: labelPlacement
props.description: Position of the label relative to the switch

props.name: loading
props.description: Shows a loading state and blocks interaction

props.name: ripple
props.description: Shows a ripple effect on click

props.name: trackStyle
props.description: Inline styles of the track

props.name: thumbStyle
props.description: Inline styles of the thumb

props.name: icon
props.description: Custom icon

props.name: iconPlacement
props.description: Icon position: inside the thumb ("start") or after the switch ("end")

# react-form

Standalone React 19 recipe, using only public Minerva entries.

Requires Node >=22.13 and pnpm 11. Copy the complete directory, then run:

```sh
pnpm install
pnpm build
pnpm dev
```

The package manifest pins the tested Minerva/framework/tool versions. The entry imports the global stylesheet once. App owns the provider and controlled state. No documentation translation setup or workspace aliases are required.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: A native checkbox with role="switch": Space and Enter toggle it, and minerva-change reports the new state.

styles-states.title: Styles and states
styles-states.description: Sizes, square shape, colors, label placement, an icon in the thumb, and the read-only, invalid and no-ripple variants. Toggling Sync shows the loading state.

side-labels.title: Side labels and segments
side-labels.description: off-label and on-label add clickable labels on both sides of the slider; variant="segmented" turns them into a two-segment control.

form.title: In a form
form.description: Like a checkbox: a switch that is on submits its value, required keeps the form invalid until it is on, and reset restores the checked attributes.

props.noRipple: Disables the ripple effect on click.
props.readOnly: Read-only: focusable and submitted, but the user cannot toggle it.
props.required: The switch must be on for the form to be submitted.
props.isDisabled: Whether the control is disabled, by itself or by a disabled <fieldset> (read-only).
props.labels: The <label> elements associated with the element (read-only).
props.validationMessage: Message of the current validation error; empty when valid (read-only).
props.willValidate: Whether the element takes part in constraint validation (read-only).

events.change: The state changed (re-dispatched from the inner input).
events.minerva-change: The user toggled the switch; detail: { checked, value }.

slots.default: Label content (alternative to the label attribute).
slots.icon: Icon inside the thumb (icon-placement="start") or after the switch ("end").

methods.blur: Removes focus from the inner control.
methods.click: Clicks the inner input (toggles the switch unless it is blocked).
methods.checkValidity: Checks validity; fires invalid when the element is invalid.
methods.reportValidity: Checks validity and shows the browser's validation message.
methods.setCustomValidity: Sets a custom validation error, or clears it with an empty string.
methods.formResetCallback: Form lifecycle callback called by form.reset(): restores the initial value.
methods.formDisabledCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when an ancestor <fieldset> is disabled or enabled.
methods.formStateRestoreCallback: Form lifecycle callback called when the browser restores the state (history navigation, autofill).
